WAD is NATting to the wrong IP pool address for the interface.
Inbound traffic on the interface bandwidth widget shows 0 bps on the VLAN interface.
Long lasting sessions are expired on HA secondary device with a 10G interface.
Interface link status of HA members go down when cfg-revert tries to reboot post cfg-revert-timeout.

HA is out-of-sync due to certificatelocal in FGSP standalone cluster.
Unable to synchronize IPsec SA between FGCP members after upgrading.
In the FortiOS MIB files, the trap fields fgFwIppStatsGroupName and fgFwIppStatsInusePBAs have the same OID. As a result, the fgFwIppStatsInusePBAs field always returns a value of 0.
iked ignores phase 1 configuration changes due to frequent FortiExtender CMDB changes.
FortiGate IPsec tunnel role could be incorrect after rebooting or upgrading, and causes negotiation to be stuck when it comes up.
IPsec phase 2 fails when both HA cluster members reboot at the same time.
A deny policy with log traffic disabled is generating logs.
FortiGate refuses incoming TCP connection to FTP proxy port after explicit proxy related configurations are changed.
WAD crash occurs when TLS 1.2 receives the client certificate and that server-facing SSL port has been closed due to the SSL bypass.
IPv6 route redistribution metric value is not taking effect.
Upgrading from 6.4.8 to 7.0.5 causes SDN firewall address configurations to be lost.
Only the first ACI SDN connector can be kept after upgrading from 6.4.8 if multiple ACI SDN connectors are configured.
Azure Fabric connector process (azd) has high memory consumption during updates, which leads to entry-level FortiGate models entering conserve mode.
Updated empty group with SAML user does not trigger an SSL VPN firewall policy refresh, which causes the SAML user detection to not be successful in later usage.
SSL VPN web portal redirect fails in http://qu***.jj***.bu***.
SSL VPN web mode cannot display certain websites that are internal bookmarks.

Authentication request of SSL VPN realm can now only be sent to user group, local user, and remote group that is mapped to that realm in the SSL VPN settings. The authentication request will not be applied to the user group and remote group of non-realm or other realms.
When trying to create a support ticket in Jira with SSL VPN proxy web mode, the dropdown field does not contain any values.
SSL VPN crashes after copying a string to the remote server using the clipboard in RDP web mode when using RDP security.
SSL VPN web mode is unable to access EMS server.
Getting re-authentication pop-up window for VNC quick connection over SSL VPN web proxy.
RDP over VPN SSL web mode stops work after upgrading to 6.4.10.
User peer feature for one group to match to multiple user peers in the authentication rules is broken.
Unable to access Synology NAS server through SSL VPN web mode.

Browser displays an Error, Feature is not available message if a file larger than 1 MB is uploaded from FTP or SMB using a web bookmark, even though the file is uploaded successfully. There are no issues with downloading files.
Enabling allowed-vlans-all on FortiSwitch ports will push VLANs from both owner and tenant VDOMs.
The flcfgd daemon crashes frequently on the HA passive unit.
HA synchronization packets are hashed to a single queue when sync-packet-balance is enabled.
Not all ports are coming up after an LAG bounce on 8 × 10 GB LAG with ASR9K. Affected platforms: FG-3960E and FG-3980E.
FG-100F HA secondary's unused ports flaps from down to up, then to down.
Add SNMP MIB support for PBA pools.
IPv4 session is flushed after creating a new VDOM.

When a virtual switch member port is set to be an alternate by STP, it should not reply with ARP; otherwise, the connected device will learn the MAC address from the alternate port and send subsequent packets to the alternate port.
Deleting a VDOM that contains EMAC interfaces might affect the interface bandwidth widget of the parent VLAN.
DDNS is not working when cleartext is enabled.
EHP and HRX drop on NP6 FortiGate, causing low throughput.
Ports 33-35 constantly show suspect messaging in the transceiver output. Affected platforms: FG-2600F and FG-2601F.
LACP interfaces are flapping after upgrading to 6.4.9.
Slow upload speeds when connected to FIOS connection. Affected platforms: NP6Lite and NP6xLite.
QSFP and QSFP+ Fortinet transceivers are not operational on FG-3401E.
The reply-to option in the email server settings is no longer visible in a default server configuration.
FortiGate may not provide detailed information during a watchdog-initiated reboot.
As the size of the internet service database expands, ffdb_err_msg_print:ret=-4, Error:kernelerror is observed frequently on 32-bit CPU platforms, such as the FG-100E.
GUI CLI console displays a Connectionlost message when logging in as an API administrator.
Can'tfindxitem.Droptheresponse. error appears for DHCPOFFER packets in the DHCP relay debug.
Session synchronization packets may be dropped when using HA1/HA2. Affected platforms: FGT-420xF and FGT-440xF.
After upgrading, the AV filter feature set is changed from proxy mode to flow mode.
When MAC-based authentication is enabled, multiple RADIUS authentication requests may be sent at the same time. This results in duplicate sessions for the same device.
Subject Alternative Name (SAN) is missing from the certificate upon automatic certificate renewal made by the FortiGate.

Local-in policies for authentication disappear and the authentication page returns a ERR_ CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT error. The authentication page is not displayed because it is not rebuilt when firewalllocal-in-policy is added, edited, or deleted.
FG-81F 802.1X MAC authentication bypass (MAB) failed to authenticate Cisco AP.
FWF-8xF platforms should allow the DHCP server configuration of an aggregate interface (aplink) to be edited in the GUI.
FortiGate is not sending RADIUS accounting message consistently to RADIUS server for wireless SSO.

On the Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy page in 6.4.0 onwards, the IPv4 and IPv6 policy tables are combined but the custom section name (global label) is not automatically checked for duplicates. If there is a duplicate custom section name, the policy list may show empty for that section. This is a display issue only and does not impact policy traffic.
observations.workaround: rename the custom section to unique name between IPv4 and IPv6 policies.

observations.description: Within the Policy & Objects menu, the firewall, DoS, and traffic shaping policy pages take around five seconds to load when the FortiGate cannot reach the FortiGuard DNS servers.
observations.workaround: set the DNS server to the FortiGuard DNS server.

observations.description: Stress test shows packet loss when testing with flow inspection mode and application control.

If the first firewall service object in the service list (based on the order in the command line table) has a protocol type of IP, the GUI may incorrectly modify its protocol number whenever a new firewall service of the same protocol type IP is created in the GUI. This silent misconfiguration can result in unexpected behavior of firewall policies that use the impacted service. For example, some 6K and 7K platforms have firewall service ALL (protocol type IP) as the first service, and this can cause the ALL service to be modified unexpectedly.
observations.workaround: create a new service in the CLI, or move a non-IP type services to the top of the firewall service list. For example, if ALL is the first firewall service in the list: configfirewallservicecustom edit"unused" settcp-portrange1 next move"unused"before"ALL" end

observations.description: FortiView pages with FortiAnalyzer source incorrectly display a Failed to retrieve data error on all VDOM views when there is a newly created VDOM that is not yet registered to FortiAnalyzer. The error should only show on the new VDOM view.

On the System > FortiGuard page, the override FortiGuard server for AntiVirus & IPS Updates shows an Unknown status, even if the server is working correctly. This is a display issue only; the override feature is working properly.
Managed FortiSwitch and FortiSwitch Ports pages are slow to load when there are many managed FortiSwitches.
The web page cannot be found is displayed when a dashboard ID no longer exists.
observations.workaround: load another page in the navigation pane. Once loaded, load the original dashboard page (that displayed the error) again.

observations.description: GUI interface bandwidth widget does not show correct data for tunnel interface when ASIC offload is enabled on the firewall policy.
When there are a lot of historical logs from FortiAnalyzer, the FortiGate GUI Forward Traffic log page can take time to load if there is no specific filter for the time range.
observations.workaround: provide a specific time range filter, or use the FortiAnalyzer GUI to view the logs.

observations.description: On the Log & Report > Forward Traffic page, filtering by the Source or Destination column with negation on the IP range does not work.
Sessions not synchronized to HA secondary on an FGSP and FGCP combined setup.
FGSP does not synchronize the helper-pmap expectation session.
HA cluster upgrade fails for primary unit but works for the secondary unit if upgrading from FortiOS 6.4.11 and earlier. Affected platforms: FG-601F only.
observations.workaround: disable uninterruptable upgrades, or break the cluster and upgrade the devices separately.

observations.description: In the GUI, an FQDN or ISDB can be selected for a DoS policy, which is not supported (an error message appears). The CLI shows the correct options.
The timestamp on the hyperscale SPU of a deny policy (policy id 0) is incorrect.
Traffic shaping profile does not seem to have an effect on TCP/UDP traffic in hyperscale.
Large client IP range makes fixed allocation usage relatively limited.
IPS custom signature logging shows (even after being disabled) after upgrading to FortiOS 6.4.7.
IPsec traffic failing from FortiGate with FailedtofindIPsecCommon error when dialup IPsec VPN tunnel has remote IP configured on the IPsec VPN interface.
In an HA cluster, static routes via the IPsec tunnel interface are not inactive in the routing table when the tunnel is down.
observations.workaround: in an SD-WAN scenario, a health check for the IPsec tunnel (SD-WAN member) with update-static-routeenable is required. configsystemsdwan

observations.description: Logs are not seen for traffic passing through the firewall caused by numerous simultaneous configuration changes.
When viewing logs on the Log & Report > System Events page, filtering by domain\username does not display matching entries.
observations.workaround: use a double backslash (domain\\username) while filtering or searching by username only without the domain.

observations.description: WAD process with SoC SSL acceleration enabled consumes more memory usage over time, which may lead to conserve mode.
observations.workaround: disable SoC SSL acceleration under the firewall SSL settings.

observations.description: Connectionfailed error occurs on FortiGate when an interface is created and updated using the API in quick succession.
Policy routes order is changed after updating the source/destination of SD-WAN rules.
IPv6 VRRP backup is sending RA, which causes routing issues.
When there are a lot of policies (several thousand), the interface member selection for the SD-WAN Zone dialog may take up to a minute to load.
observations.workaround: use the CLI to configure the SD-WAN zone.

observations.description: Slow GUI performance in large Fabric topology with over 50 downstream devices.
The dstaddr/dstaddr6 of an SSL VPN policy can be set to all when split tunnel mode is enabled and only the default portal is set.
Forward traffic log does not generate logs for HTTP and HTTPS services with SSL VPN web mode.

When NTurbo is enabled, it is unexpectedly provided with the wrong traffic direction information (from server or from client) to decide the destination for the data. This causes the traffic to be sent back to the port where it came from.
The extender daemon crashes on Low Encryption (LENC) FortiGates.
Link status on peer device is not down when the admin port is down on the FG-500E.
A VWP named .. can be created in the GUI, but it cannot be edited or deleted.
Interface belonging to other VDOMs should be removed from interface list when configuring a GENEVE interface.
VXLAN VNI interface cannot be used with a hardware switch.

FortiGate did not restart after restoring the backup configuration via FortiManager after the following process: disable NPU offloading, change NGFW mode from profile-based to policy-based, retrieve configuration from FortiGate via FortiManager, and install the policy package via FortiManager.
The forticron process uses high CPU.
Traffic passing through an EMAC VLAN interface when the parent interface is in another VDOM is blocked if NP7 offloading is enabled.
observations.workaround: set the auto-asic-offload option to disable in the firewall policy.

observations.description: Random LTE modem disconnections due to certain carriers getting unstable due to WWAN modem USB speed under super-speed.
High memory usage caused by downloading a large CRL list.
DHCP relay does not work properly with two DHCP relay servers configured.
Console keeps displaying bcm_nl.nr_request_drop... after the FortiGate reboots because of the cfg-saverevert setting under configsystemglobal. Affected platforms: FG-10xF and FG-20xF.
FG-20xF system halts if setting cfg-save to revert under configsystemglobal and after the cfg-revert-timeout occurs.
There may be a race condition between the CMDB initializing and the customer language file loading, which causes the customer language file to be removed after upgrading.
observations.workaround: re-upload the customer language file after the FortiGate boots up.

observations.description: High CPU utilization occurs when relay is enabled on VLAN, and this prevents users from getting an IP from DHCP.
If the firewall session is in check-new mode, FortiOS will not flush its NPU offload entry when there is a MAC address update of its gateway.
The asicdos option for enabling/disabling NP6XLite DoS offloading is missing after upgrading to 6.4.9. Affected platforms: NP6XLite.
When upgrading from 6.0.15 to 6.4.11, an existing explicit flow-based web filter profile changes to proxy-based.

Upgrading FortiOS firmware with a local file from 6.2.13, 6.4.12, 7.0.11, or 7.2.4 and earlier may fail for certain models because the image file size exceeds the upload limit. Affected models: FortiGate 6000 and 7000 series, FWF-80F-2R, and FWF-81F-2R-POE.
observations.workaround: upgrade the firmware using FortiGuard, or manually increase the HTTP request size limit to 200 MB. configsystemglobal sethttp-request-limit200000000 end

observations.description: SCEP fails to renew if the local certificate name length is between 31 and 35 characters.
When a search is performed on a user (User & Authentication > User Definition page), the search results highlight all the groups the user belongs to.
Azure SDN connector replicates configuration from primary device to secondary device during configuration restore.
FG-VMX manager not showing all the nodes deployed.
Autoscale GCP health check is not successful (port 8443 HTTPS).
During every FortiGuard UTM update, there is high CPU usage because only one vCPU is available.
Incorrect VMDK file size in the OVF file for hw13 and hw15.
observations.workaround: manually correct the hw13 and hw15 OVF file's ovf:size value.

observations.description: The security-redirect-url setting is missing when the portal-type is auth-mac.
HTTPS sessions to some internal destinations are randomly dropped for users from the same group set.
EICAR virus test file HTTPS traffic cannot be blocked, even when there is a block IPS log.
Primary and secondary units of HA cluster are not accessible and drop traffic.
Application control filename field has unexpected character and breaks the syslog format.
IPS engine is crashing.
IPS engine crashes and FortiGate enters conserve mode. IPS engine stalled and IPS fail-open is triggered.
IPS is causing high memory (FortiOS 6.4.8)
IPS engine is consuming high memory.
High IPS engine memory usage after device upgrade.
In flow mode, URL filter configuration changes cause a spike in CPU usage of the IPS engine process.
Both block and passthrough logs are sent out by the web filter override function.
ZIP file block does not work as expected with flow-mode DLP.
URLs longer than 8000 characters are unable to get a FortiGuard rating with flow-based URL filter.
